answer.script:
//@version=5
// Built from: Delta Volume BOS Night Shift (VWMA trend + volume structure), RSI pullback trigger. Indicators: math.sum, ta.rsi, ta.highest, ta.lowest, ta.crossover, ta.crossunder.
strategy("VWMA RSI Pullback 2m", overlay=true, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, initial_capital=50000)
pv = input.float(50, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
use_session = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0, "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn = input.int(0, "Session End Minute")
cur_time = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
start_time = sess_start_hr * 60 + sess_start_mn
end_time = sess_end_hr * 60 + sess_end_mn
in_session = use_session ? (start_time < end_time ? (cur_time >= start_time and cur_time < end_time) : (cur_time >= start_time or cur_time < end_time)) : true
cooldown_bars = input.int(12, "Cooldown Bars", minval=1, maxval=100)
var int last_entry_bar = 0
vwma_len = input.int(20, "VWMA Length", minval=5, maxval=100)
vol_sum = math.sum(volume, vwma_len)
price_sum = math.sum(close * volume, vwma_len)
vwma = vol_sum > 0 ? price_sum / vol_sum : close
rsi_len = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=5, maxval=50)
rsi_val = ta.rsi(close, rsi_len)
rsi_os = input.int(35, "RSI Oversold", minval=10, maxval=45)
rsi_ob = input.int(65, "RSI Overbought", minval=55, maxval=90)
swing_len = input.int(10, "Swing Length", minval=5, maxval=50)
recent_high = ta.highest(high[1], swing_len)
recent_low = ta.lowest(low[1], swing_len)
trend_long = close > vwma
trend_short = close < vwma
rsi_long_trig = ta.crossover(rsi_val, rsi_os)
rsi_short_trig = ta.crossunder(rsi_val, rsi_ob)
pullback_long = low <= recent_low and close > open
pullback_short = high >= recent_high and close < open
cooldown_ok = bar_index - last_entry_bar >= cooldown_bars
long_sig = in_session and trend_long and rsi_long_trig and pullback_long and cooldown_ok
short_sig = in_session and trend_short and rsi_short_trig and pullback_short and cooldown_ok
if long_sig
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    last_entry_bar := bar_index
if short_sig
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
    last_entry_bar := bar_index
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars) and strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
    strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")
if not in_session and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session")
